title: Case: Customs broker chasing the commercial invoice for a held shipment of woven throws
context: A carton of woven throws is held at import until the customs broker lodges an entry. The shipper has given the desk the commercial invoice to pass to the broker. Today's clearance run closes at 14:00 UTC.
initial_request: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-5563 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

events.body: Morning. Commercial invoice CI-6838 for DL-5563 attached for the broker, PDF, 3 pages. HS codes are on page 2, declared value on page 3. Shout if he needs anything else, I'm in the weaving shed most of the day so email is slow.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-93061 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
DL-77481 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.from: Jory Pilkington, customs broker, Whinmoor Customs
events.body: DL-5563 is held at import. I need the commercial invoice with HS codes to lodge the entry. Upload it against DL-5563 in this portal: documents uploaded here go straight onto the entry file. Cut-off for today's clearance run is 14:00 UTC. Miss it and it rolls to tomorrow's run.
DL-41904 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.to: Jory Pilkington, customs broker, Whinmoor Customs
events.body: Attached is commercial invoice CI-6838 for DL-5563 from the shipper, Fernwick Looms (PDF, 3 pages; HS codes on page 2). Please confirm it is enough to lodge the entry today.

Notice to sender: your message "DL-5563 commercial invoice" was delivered with 1 attachment removed. Policy: attachments from external senders are removed and deleted, not quarantined. The message text was delivered to the recipient.
For information: storage on DL-5563 starts to accrue from 2028-04-06 if the shipment is not cleared. Any charge is assessed by us after clearance. There is no figure yet.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Wednesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

events.from: Jory Pilkington, customs broker, Whinmoor Customs
events.body: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-5563 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

acceptable_actions.recipient: Jory Pilkington, customs broker, Whinmoor Customs
acceptable_actions.summary: Provide commercial invoice CI-6838 against DL-5563 through the Broker portal, the route the broker asked for, and ask him to confirm it is on the entry file before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

must: Send the invoice to the broker through the Broker portal against DL-5563
Identify the document as commercial invoice CI-6838 from Fernwick Looms
Ask the broker to confirm the document has reached the entry file
must_not: Tell the broker the invoice has already been sent or ask him to look at the earlier email again
Send the invoice as an email attachment to the broker again
State that DL-5563 will clear today or make the 14:00 UTC run
Quote, estimate or offer to waive storage or import charges
Push the task back to the shipper to resend when the desk already holds the invoice
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Commercial invoice CI-6838 for DL-5563, from the shipper Fernwick Looms, is uploaded here against the shipment: PDF, 3 pages, HS codes on page 2, declared value on page 3. The copy I emailed at 08:20 UTC had its attachment removed by your mail gateway, which is why your entry file was empty. Please confirm you can see the document on the entry file and whether it is enough to lodge before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-205: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
